news_items.headline: Analog Devices (ADI) Is Up 7.57% in One Week
news_items.summary: ADI shares are up 7.57% over the past week, outpaced only marginally by the Zacks Semiconductor - Analog and Mixed industry (+12.06%). Past quarter +24.88%, last year +107.63%. Projected 46.1% earnings growth this fiscal year; Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

news_items.headline: Analog Devices (ADI) Is Up 5.6% After Analyst Upgrades Ahead Of Earnings
news_items.summary: ADI rallied 5.6% following analyst upgrades pointing to stronger EPS and revenue ahead of the upcoming Q2 2026 earnings release on May 20.

news_items.headline: Citi places ADI on 30-day positive catalyst watch list citing AI/data center demand
news_items.summary: Citi reiterated Buy with $400 price target, expecting April and July quarter results to exceed estimates due to higher analog chip pricing and sustained AI/data center demand.

news_items.headline: ADI rising AI and data center revenue share reframes earnings power story
news_items.summary: AI and data center exposure now accounts for roughly one-fifth of ADI revenue, becoming central to the business mix and supporting expectations of continued growth.

news_items.headline: Evaluating Analog Devices (ADI) Valuation As Earnings Optimism And CEO Stock Sale Draw Attention
news_items.summary: Article weighs earnings optimism against CEO Vincent Roche's recent ~$3.98M stock sale. Insider sales near all-time highs noted as a flag while broader sentiment remains constructive into May 20 earnings.

news_items.headline: How Investors Are Reacting To Analog Devices Balancing Higher Earnings Hopes With Mixed Execution Trends
news_items.summary: Investors balance raised earnings expectations against mixed execution trends. Sentiment skews positive but execution risk into the print is flagged.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Current month: 27 Buy / 2 Hold / 0 Sell. JPMorgan, Barclays, and UBS have recently raised price targets. Citi reiterated Buy with $400 PT on AI/data center catalyst watch. 12-month consensus PT $393.16 (high $475, low $295); 3-month avg PT $395.95.

earnings_context.notes: Q2 2026 earnings release on May 20, 2026 is the dominant near-term catalyst. February 2026 guidance was Q2 revenue ~$3.5B and EPS ~$2.19; analyst upgrades suggest street expects a beat driven by AI/data center revenue ramp and higher analog chip pricing. S&P Global upgraded issuer credit rating to 'A' from 'A-' on April 17, 2026 with stable outlook (older context, already priced in).
